svg.text: Current opening mechanics. Later chapters remix these encounters. Endless play has no level picker.
Orange: lethal hazards. Mint: bouncy wedges. Purple: vortex pull boundary. White: collectible stars.
Select a Mektra_level_N group to inspect/edit; its background preserves the exact 390 x 1080 export size.
Read the next landing. Launch across the gap.
Wide targets are safer. Small targets carry bonus stars.
Lead the moving target before you launch.
Orange rings count down. Leave before the platform crumbles.
Watch the orange gate. Commit when it clears your path.
Room to breathe. Collect stars and find your next opening.
Read the moving gate, then leave the crumbling landing.
